import pytesseract

# Write each line of OCR output into its own row starting at row 2
lines = text.splitlines()
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=2):

max_len = max((len(str(ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value or "")) for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1)), default=10)

out_path = "output/invoice_ocr.xlsx"
import os
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
wb.save(out_path)
print(f"\\nExcel file saved to: {out_path}")
